stages.text: Report to Warden Aldren in Emoria Watch.
Visit Master Oddrin, the Ring Sage, for your first ring.
Meet Guild Scout Vel on the Hollow Road, north of the village.
Find out what the Gyria are doing at Ashfen Camp in the eastern woods.
Defeat Warchief Vorga (draft name) at the war tent north of the camp.
Return to Warden Aldren with news of Ashfen.
Bind a wild creature in the tall grass with a Binding Ring.
Show Master Oddrin your new creature.
Kesh, a Gyria scout, is held captive in her own camp. Decide what to do.
Tell Warden Aldren what you decided about Kesh.
Ilith wants you to read the Glassmere Stone, on the lake's south-west shore.
Tell Ilith what the stone says.
